• The Totality gear shop, where you can directly purchase Modified B-7 Pistol and Praxic Blade modifiers for Credits. You also receive additional gear when you increase your reputation rank.

• Renegade Abilities can be unlocked and purchased from Armorer Aghol.

• Weekly shipments, which can be increased in size based on your current Reputation.
displayProperties.name: TOTALITY REPUTATION INFO
